title: Taxifolin Attenuates Remote Lung Injury Induced by Hepatic Ischemia-Reperfusion in Rats.
authors: Erbatur, Serkan; Erbatur, Meral Erdal; Sahin, Firat; Bilge, Huseyin; Ekinci, Aysun
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨花旗松素对肝缺血再灌注致肺损伤的保护作用，涉及NF-kB/HMGB1信号通路，但核心是动物实验与炎症机制，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Hepatic ischemia-reperfusion (I/R) injury induces systemic oxidative stress and inflammatory responses that may lead to remote lung injury. This study investigated whether taxifolin attenuates hepatic I/R-induced lung damage and examined the involvement of the nuclear factor-kappaB (NF-kappaB) and high-mobility group box-1 (HMGB1) signaling axis. METHODS: Twenty-eight male Wistar rats were divided into four groups (n = 7): control, taxifolin, hepatic I/R, and taxifolin+I/R. Serum oxidative stress markers (malondialdehyde [MDA], interleukin [IL]-6, total antioxidant/oxidant status [TAS/TOS]) and wet-to-dry lung weight ratio were measured. Lung tissues were evaluated histopathologically and immunohistochemically for NF-kappaB and HMGB1 expression. Bioinformatics pathway enrichment and molecular docking analyses were also performed. RESULTS: Hepatic I/R significantly increased serum MDA, IL-6, and TOS levels and decreased TAS (p < 0.05). Severe lung injury was observed in the hepatic I/R group (median score: 11), whereas taxifolin pretreatment significantly reduced the injury score (median score: 5, p < 0.001). NF-kappaB and HMGB1 expression were markedly elevated following hepatic I/R and significantly decreased with taxifolin treatment (p < 0.05). A strong positive correlation was found between NF-kappaB and HMGB1 expression (r = 0.82, p < 0.001). Pathway enrichment analysis indicated involvement of Toll-like receptor (TLR)-related inflammatory signaling, and docking analysis demonstrated favorable binding of taxifolin to TLR4 and NF-kappaB p65. CONCLUSION: Taxifolin attenuated hepatic I/R-induced lung injury by reducing oxidative stress and suppressing HMGB1-TLR4-NF-kappaB-mediated inflammatory signaling.
abstract_zh: 背景：肝脏缺血再灌注（I/R）损伤会诱发系统性氧化应激和炎症反应，可能导致远端肺损伤。本研究探讨了花旗松素（taxifolin）是否减轻肝脏I/R诱导的肺损伤，并考察了核因子-κB（NF-kappaB）和高迁移率族蛋白盒-1（HMGB1）信号轴的参与。方法：将二十八只雄性Wistar大鼠分为四组（每组n = 7）：对照组、花旗松素组、肝脏I/R组和花旗松素+I/R组。检测血清氧化应激标志物（丙二醛[MDA]、白细胞介素[IL]-6、总抗氧化/氧化状态[TAS/TOS]）和肺湿干重比。对肺组织进行组织病理学评估，并通过免疫组织化学检测NF-kappaB和HMGB1表达。还进行了生物信息学通路富集和分子对接分析。结果：肝脏I/R显著增加血清MDA、IL-6和TOS水平，并降低TAS（p < 0.05）。肝脏I/R组观察到严重肺损伤（中位评分：11），而花旗松素预处理显著降低损伤评分（中位评分：5，p < 0.001）。肝脏I/R后NF-kappaB和HMGB1表达显著升高，花旗松素处理后显著降低（p < 0.05）。NF-kappaB和HMGB1表达之间存在强正相关（r = 0.82，p < 0.001）。通路富集分析表明涉及Toll样受体（TLR）相关炎症信号，对接分析显示花旗松素与TLR4和NF-kappaB p65具有良好的结合能力。结论：花旗松素通过减少氧化应激和抑制HMGB1-TLR4-NF-kappaB介导的炎症信号，减轻了肝脏I/R诱导的肺损伤。
